items.prompt: Why can virtual size exceed resident memory?

options.text: Every mapped byte must be private physical RAM now
A virtual address always identifies a live C++ object
Mapped ranges need not all be resident simultaneously
options.why: Residency/backing/access policies govern actual physical use.

options.text: RSS is always a globally unique physical byte count
options.why: Shared pages can be counted across processes.

items.explanation: Virtual address-space accounting is not a direct sum of currently private physical pages.
